article.title: How Much Is Our Freedom Worth? Ending Corporate Support for Fascism
article.author: Saqib Bhatti
article.content: Americans are guaranteed the right to have a say in who represents us in making decisions about our healthcare system, the quality of air we breathe, and how immigrants are treated. Yet the Trump regime has been laying the groundwork to interfere with our right to vote for months, and that effort will likely continue long after tomorrow’s elections.
